description: Iteration 2 figure: cryo-EM disorder of the AP5B1 appendage in 8YAH, conserved-surface test against AP-2 ear positive controls, and location of the conserved patches relative to the canonical ligand site
code:
# Figure for iteration 2.
# Panel (a) is computed LIVE here: it re-downloads the deposited mmCIF for 8YAH
# (AP5-SPG11-SPG15, PMID 40175557) and recomputes which residues of each subunit
# are present in the model.
# Panels (b) and (c) plot values computed by provenance/ap5b1/06_conserved_patch.py
# and provenance/ap5b1/07_positive_control_beta2.py (run in the shell; JSON saved there).

import requests
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

txt = requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/8YAH.cif", timeout=600).text
lines = txt.splitlines()

def loop(prefix):
    i = 0
    while i < len(lines):
        if lines[i].startswith(prefix):
            cols = []
            while lines[i].startswith(prefix):
                cols.append(lines[i].strip().split(".")[1]); i += 1
            rows = []
            while i < len(lines) and not lines[i].startswith("#"):
                f = lines[i].split()
                if len(f) == len(cols):
                    rows.append(dict(zip(cols, f)))
                i += 1
            return rows
        i += 1
    return []

atoms = loop("_atom_site.")
seqs  = loop("_entity_poly_seq.")
con = {}
for r in seqs:
    con[r["entity_id"]] = max(con.get(r["entity_id"], 0), int(r["num"]))
mod = {}
for r in atoms:
    if r.get("group_PDB") == "ATOM":
        mod.setdefault(r["label_entity_id"], set()).add(int(r["label_seq_id"]))

names = {"1": "AP5Z1 (zeta)", "2": "AP5B1 (beta5)", "3": "AP5S1 (sigma)",
         "4": "AP5M1 (mu)", "5": "SPG11 (spatacsin)"}
print("entity  name                 construct  modelled  last")
for e in sorted(con, key=int):
    rs = sorted(mod.get(e, []))
    print(f"{e:>6}  {names[e]:<20} {con[e]:>9} {len(rs):>9} {rs[-1]:>5}")

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(13.5, 9.5))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, height_ratios=[1.0, 1.0], hspace=0.40, wspace=0.26)

# ---- (a) ordered vs disordered per subunit, live from 8YAH ----
ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :])
order = ["5", "1", "2", "4", "3"]
for y, e in enumerate(order):
    L = con[e]; rs = sorted(mod.get(e, []))
    ax.barh(y, L, color="#e9e9ee", edgecolor="#b0b0bb", height=0.55, zorder=1)
    s = prev = rs[0]
    for k in rs[1:] + [None]:
        if k is None or k != prev + 1:
            ax.barh(y, prev - s + 1, left=s, color="#2f6fb5", height=0.55, zorder=2)
            s = k
        prev = k
    ax.text(L + 40, y, f"{len(rs)}/{L} modelled ({100*len(rs)/L:.0f}%)", va="center", fontsize=9)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(order)))
ax.set_yticklabels([names[e] for e in order], fontsize=10)
ax.set_xlabel("residue number in the deposited construct")
ax.set_xlim(0, 3150); ax.set_ylim(-1.25, len(order) - 0.4)
iy = order.index("2")
ax.annotate("", xy=(878, iy - 0.42), xytext=(632, iy - 0.42),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="<->", color="#c23b22", lw=1.6))
ax.text(900, iy - 0.75, "AP5B1 632-878: predicted appendage, absent from the map\n(247 residues, 28% of the chain)",
        ha="left", color="#c23b22", fontsize=9.5)
ax.set_title("(a) AP-5 cryo-EM structure 8YAH (3.3 A, PMID 40175557): blue is modelled, grey is unresolved.\n"
             "Every subunit is near-complete except the AP5B1 C-terminal appendage.", fontsize=10.5, loc="left")

# ---- (b) conserved-surface test, AP5B1 vs positive controls ----
ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
rows = [
    ("AP-2 beta2 ear\nIVF, sandwich site",        0.812, 0.388, 5e-5,   "#2f6fb5"),
    ("AP-2 beta2 ear\nEps15, sandwich site",      0.687, 0.384, 5e-5,   "#2f6fb5"),
    ("AP-2 alpha ear\nFxDxF, side site",          0.568, 0.334, 0.0001, "#2f6fb5"),
    ("AP-2 alpha ear\nFxDxF, platform site",      0.443, 0.341, 0.0218, "#2f6fb5"),
    ("AP-2 beta2 ear\narrestin, platform site",   0.453, 0.412, 0.2635, "#8c8c99"),
    ("AP5B1 appendage\nplatform site",            0.219, 0.255, 0.6937, "#c23b22"),
    ("AP5B1 appendage\nsandwich site",            0.172, 0.257, 0.8639, "#c23b22"),
]
y = np.arange(len(rows))[::-1]
for yy, (lab, near, far, p, col) in zip(y, rows):
    ax.plot([far, near], [yy, yy], color=col, lw=1.4, zorder=1)
    ax.scatter([far], [yy], marker="o", s=42, facecolor="white", edgecolor=col, zorder=3)
    ax.scatter([near], [yy], marker="o", s=52, color=col, zorder=3)
    ax.text(max(near, far) + 0.02, yy, "p<5e-5" if p < 5e-5 else f"p={p:.3f}",
            va="center", fontsize=8.5, color=col)
ax.set_yticks(y); ax.set_yticklabels([r[0] for r in rows], fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_xlim(0.08, 1.02)
ax.set_xlabel("mean ortholog identity of surface residues")
ax.set_title("(b) Is the ligand site more conserved than the rest of the surface?\n"
             "open circle: rest of surface, filled: within 8 A of the bound peptide", fontsize=10, loc="left")

# ---- (c) where the conserved surface actually is on AP5B1 ----
ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
pat = [("D837", 0.643, 22.9), ("W861", 0.530, 16.2), ("S796", 0.520, 10.2), ("P771", 0.514, 20.7),
       ("P865", 0.503, 17.7), ("P713", 0.473, 51.1), ("Q772", 0.468, 19.5), ("E795", 0.466, 7.4),
       ("S692", 0.442, 44.0), ("A862", 0.432, 17.0), ("E792", 0.417, 9.1), ("P769", 0.402, 23.0),
       ("R797", 0.390, 11.6), ("D859", 0.383, 19.0), ("D869", 0.368, 20.4), ("Y691", 0.368, 42.0)]
d = np.array([p[2] for p in pat]); c = np.array([p[1] for p in pat])
ax.scatter(d, c, s=55, color="#2f6fb5", zorder=3)
for lab, cc, dd in pat:
    ax.annotate(lab, (dd, cc), textcoords="offset points", xytext=(5, 4), fontsize=8)
ax.axvspan(0, 8, color="#c23b22", alpha=0.12, zorder=0)
ax.text(4.0, 0.60, "canonical\nplatform\nligand site", ha="center", color="#c23b22", fontsize=8.5)
ax.set_xlabel("distance from the superposed AP-2 alpha ear FxDxF peptide (A)")
ax.set_ylabel("smoothed surface conservation (10 A patch)")
ax.set_title("(c) The 16 most conserved surface patches of the AP5B1 appendage\n"
             "sit 7-51 A from the canonical ligand site", fontsize=10, loc="left")
plt.show()
